# Load Session Brief

Create a concise session brief for coordinator kickoff.

## Inputs

- `docs/ai/project-memory.md`
- `docs/ai/current-plan.md`
- `docs/ai/sessions/current-session.md`
- latest dated session note if needed

## Output

- Active scope
- Current step
- Last completed checkpoint
- Blockers
- First recommended action
